title: Representative models and normalization of finite comparisons
statement: For an adic coefficient datum and a cartesian open-immersion square [def-cbc-completed-finite-exchange-coordinates], use the universal scalar-extension and pullback counits to compare finite derived reduction with its ordinary complex model. Define the finite source and target model maps by applying the exact finite source and target functors and their localization factors. A finite comparison is normalized when, on every K-flat representative, its composite with this finite model map is the evaluated strict-model counit followed by the prescribed ordinary source or target level coordinate change. These are exactly the existing cbcFiniteReductionModelMap, cbcFiniteSourceModelMap, cbcFiniteTargetModelMap, CbcSourceFiniteNormalization and CbcTargetFiniteNormalization definitions, moved without changing their bodies or signatures.

source.place: Finite-exchange/reduction identification before Rlim; Stacks 03DI, sites-modules.tex, lemma-extension-by-zero; completed-ring strict exchange is an agent-written refinement.

proof_origin.place: Step 7, with the normalized representative equation made explicit.

def cbcFiniteReductionModelMap (T : Scheme.{u}) (n : ℕ)
    (P : CochainComplex (pbcModules T (pbcAdicCompletion T d)) ℤ) :
    (cbcFiniteReduction d T n).obj (DerivedCategory.Q.obj P) ⟶
      DerivedCategory.Q.obj
        (((cbcFiniteReductionModule d T n).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj P)
